Production passes the session factory and the catch resolver; checks rely on the same-module defaults (framework Q4: no hidden global composition left).

The fishing runtime services of one feature: FishingController (equipment consumption rules), CastService (cast start), FightSessionFactory (per-fight composition), FishingForceService, CatchResolutionService (auto-catch/landing decisions) and FightService (the per-frame fight orchestration over them).
